title: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam: Kouhen Uchuu o Kakeru
native_title: 機動戦士Ｚガンダム ～後編 宇宙を駆ける～
overview:
The second volume of the Saturn adaptation of the Mobile Suit Z Gundam anime picks up the story after Zeta no Kodou. Take the controls of the series' mobile suits and battle through stages that follow the events of the TV series in this single-player action game.

- Continues the story of the first volume
- Memory backup support
